subject: job-cost-exceptions
title: Which job costs need a second look? A sample exception report
description:
A walk through a sample job costing exception report for an invented construction company, made for contractors with several active jobs: budget against actual for each job, and the costs worth a second look.

Job-Cost Exception Report: a pilot offer from Amber One. The sample uses an invented business and invented data. A person reviews every report before it goes to you. Narrated with a synthetic voice.

#construction #jobcosting

See the sample report and the pilot terms: https://hq.amberoneai.com/offers/job-cost-exceptions?src=youtube&utm_campaign=job-cost-sample-walkthrough
narration: Overruns and miscoded costs often show up only when a job is closed.
This sample, for an invented builder, puts each job's budget, spending and percent complete side by side.
Then it lists exceptions for review: a cost code over budget, a possible duplicate bill, a cost on a closed job. Each one names the transactions behind it.
It's read only. Nothing in your books is changed, and it's not accounting advice. It flags questions for you or your bookkeeper.
